vg_starglass.name: Vigil Glass
vg_starglass.desc: Ground lens-blanks, clear as a held breath. The Builder and the forge use it.

vg_nightcap.name: Nightcap
vg_nightcap.desc: A knitted cap. Smells of lavender and, faintly, of permission. Calms you (Dread -60).

vg_clear_draught.name: Clear Draught
vg_clear_draught.desc: Cold water drawn through a lens. Clears the head and the eyes. Restores 60 health and cures what ails you.

vg_star_plate.name: Star Plate
vg_star_plate.desc: A glass plate of a star that has since moved. Sells well to collectors.

vg_lens_key.name: Iris-Key
vg_lens_key.desc: A bronze iris-key, still warm from the Orrery's wire. It turns the iris at the east end of the Orrery Hall.

vg_receipt.name: Receipt: the Vigil
vg_receipt.desc: Received of the Vigil, the Signal. The Order will watch the east until I send word that it is done, and then they may close their eyes. I have never asked anyone for a longer promise. Held in trust. -A.

vg_given_flame.name: Hale's Candle-End
vg_given_flame.desc: A candle-flame in a thimble of glass, offered, not lent. It is very small and entirely steady.

vg_sixfold_chart.name: Sixfold Chart
vg_sixfold_chart.desc: A star-chart with six wheels in six colours. Hale says it is a recipe.

vg_unsleeping_eye.name: Unsleeping Eye
vg_unsleeping_eye.desc: A flake of the Eye's lens, set in a black ring. It never closes.

vg_astrolabe_rod.name: Astrolabe Rod
vg_astrolabe_rod.desc: A brass rod with a star-wheel at the tip. For the Dealer's pool and the forge.

vg_nightcloak.name: Night Cloak
vg_nightcloak.desc: A cloak that drinks light. For the Dealer's pool and the forge.
